description:
Get the store's webhook and its last 20 deliveries, newest first. A delivery's status is pending, delivered, failed or exhausted (no more retries); anything missed can be caught up from iap_list_events. Store key scope: events:read.

Params: store_id, session_token?
Returns: {webhook: {id, url, events, active, createdAt, lastTriggeredAt} | null, deliveries: [{id, eventId, eventType, status, attempt, statusCode, error, createdAt, deliveredAt}]}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_get_webhook
title: Get store webhook
